name: ReadFromCsvTextNode
label: Read From CSV Text
description: Generates a data table from a CSV text.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: TrimFields
fields.label: Trim Fields
fields.description: If true, trims whitespace from fields.

fields.name: FirstLineContainsColumnNames
fields.label: First Line Contains Column Names
fields.description: If true, treats the first line as column names.

fields.name: GetCsvFieldsAsText
fields.label: Get CSV Fields as Text
fields.description: If true, converts all fields to text.

fields.name: ColumnsSeparator
fields.label: Columns Separator
fields.description: Specifies how columns are separated in the CSV text.

selectOptions.label: Predefined
selectOptions.description: Use a predefined separator (comma by default).

fields.name: CustomSeparator
fields.label: Custom Separator
fields.description: The custom separator to use when 'Columns Separator' is 'Custom'.

fields.name: FixedColumnWidths
fields.label: Fixed Column Widths
fields.description: The fixed widths of columns when 'Columns Separator' is 'Fixed Column Widths'.
